about_the_game:
Backpack Jianghu is currently in playtest phase. If you’re interested in joining, add the QQ Group to get a test activation code.

QQ Group 1: 632197923

As the beta version continues to improve, we will launch an open demo.

Backpack jianghu is a inventory management and battle royale game. Choose a starting sect, enter the world with 99 others, pick your path, battle and grow, and compete in the final showdown at Mount Hua's peak.

Manage Your Pack, Plan Your Build

Inspired by Backpack Battles, but with big innovations. Use inner energy to boost skills, upgrade weapons, combine low-tier skills into high-tier ones, and use skill fragments to permanently level up abilities.

Get creative with 200+ items. Make overpowered builds like:

  • Lonely Nine Swords – attack 20 times in a row, each hit applying armor break and bleed.

  • Taichi Mastery – counter-attack automatically when hit.

  • Dragon Strike – deal 99,999 damage in one blow, ignoring armor.

  • Qiankun Dodge – evade and reflect the next attack.

Every strategy has a counter. The possibilities are endless.

Open World, Final Showdown

You share the world with 99 others. Pick your path: fight, shop, find chests, rest, or risk random events.

But always remember: your goal is to reach Mount Hua’s peak and defeat everyone else.

Note: Other players are saved data, not live people. Take your time to manage your pack.

Spy on Enemies, Prepare to Fight

On the map, you can spy on enemy packs. See what items they carry. Learn their strategy and what loot they’ll drop if defeated.

Oh, and when you beat someone, you loot some items from their pack.

Twelve Sects, Unique Playstyles

Each sect starts with a different pack, items, and location. The shops, chests, events, and enemies you meet also change based on your sect.

Planned sects (may change):

  • Shaolin

  • Wudang

  • Huashan

  • Wudu Cult

  • Tianyin Cult

  • Red Blades

  • Xuanji Sect

  • Changsheng Sect

  • Emei Sect

  • Liushunmen

  • Quanzhen Sect

  • Xiayao Palace
